title: FPS COUNTER SCREEN RATE
why: His 10-27 question: a 144 cap can still show 60 fps when the browser supplies 60 screen refreshes per second.
now: The fps counter adds screen 60 when a settled screen rate is more than 5 below the selected cap. Frame timing and quality stay the same.
